title: RoleDossier
description: Layer 2 structured role dossier — canonicalized from a Layer 1 narrative report. Describes what the role is, what problem it solves, and what underlying capabilities it requires.

job_id.description: Foreign key linking to the corresponding job_record in db/jobs.jsonl.

run_id.description: Run ID during which this dossier was generated.

analysis_version.description: Version of the role_analyzer module that produced this dossier.

analyzed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this dossier was generated.

summary.description: One to three sentence summary of the role's organizational purpose.

problem_solved.description: The specific business, operational, or technical problem this role helps solve.

evidence.description: Exact phrases or sentences from the JD or report supporting this context.

primary_function.description: Primary function label (e.g. Analytics, Risk / Compliance, Engineering, Mixed / Hybrid).

function_mix_description.description: Brief description of function breakdown for hybrid roles. Empty string if not hybrid.

likely_inputs.description: Data, documents, systems, processes, customers the role works with.

likely_analyses.description: Analysis, execution, coordination, or decisions the role performs.

likely_outputs.description: Reports, decisions, code, models, documents, or recommendations the role produces.

likely_stakeholders.description: Who the role communicates with or works alongside.

jd_phrase.description: Exact or closely summarized phrase from the JD.

demand_type.description: Category of demand. domain_knowledge = field-specific knowledge; technical_skill = tool/language/platform fluency; analytical_capability = reasoning and judgment; workflow_capability = execution and process behavior; stakeholder_capability = communication and relationship behavior; business_context_knowledge = business model/market/org context; operating_judgment = prioritization and tradeoff decision-making; mixed = clearly spans multiple categories.

underlying_capability.description: What this JD phrase actually requires the person to do or understand in practice.

research_contribution.description: What research clarified, narrowed, or changed about this demand. Empty string if research adds nothing.

underlying_skill_demands.description: Translation of JD phrases into the actual demand stack (domain knowledge / technical skill / analytical / workflow / stakeholder / operating judgment). Up to 8 most important demands.

primary_workstream.description: Primary workstream label from configs/workstream_taxonomy.yaml, or 'unknown'.

workstream_evidence.description: Phrases from report or JD supporting the workstream classification.

issue.description: What is unclear in the JD or report.

impact.description: Why this uncertainty matters for understanding the role.

analyst_notes.description: Concise analyst summary: what the role is really about, who would succeed, what makes it distinct.
